en.headline: AFCD captures two unchipped mongrels on Cheung Chau after resident complaints
en.dek: The dogs were found unsupervised near Tung Tai San Tsuen and Cheung Kwai Estate on Monday and taken to an animal management centre for observation.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said on Tuesday that it had conducted a special dog-capture operation on Cheung Chau on Monday afternoon in the vicinity of Tung Tai San Tsuen and Cheung Kwai Estate.

Two unsupervised local mongrels without microchips were captured and transferred to an animal management centre for detention and observation. The department said it would check lost-and-found records to determine whether the dogs have owners.

If no keeper can be traced, staff and veterinary officers will observe the animals. Dogs confirmed to be healthy and of gentle temperament are generally transferred to partner animal-welfare organisations for sterilisation and public adoption.

The department reminded the public that unowned and uncontrolled dogs in a high-density urban environment can pose risks to safety, and that dogs over five months old must be microchipped, vaccinated against rabies and licensed.

zh.headline: 漁護署在長洲捕捉兩隻無晶片無人看管唐狗
zh.dek: 署方周一在東堤新邨及長貴邨一帶展開特別行動，兩隻唐狗已送往動物管理中心觀察。
body: 漁農自然護理署周二表示，周一在長洲東堤新邨及長貴邨一帶進行特別狗隻捕捉行動。
行動中捕捉兩隻無人看管、未有植入晶片的本地唐狗，並送往動物管理中心扣留及觀察。署方會核對報失紀錄，確定狗隻是否有畜養人。
若未能找到畜養人，中心人員及獸醫師會耐心觀察。一般情況下，確認身體健康及性情溫馴的狗隻會轉交伙伴動物福利機構接受絕育手術並安排供市民領養。
署方提醒，在高密度都市環境中，無人畜養和缺乏管束的狗隻可能對公眾安全構成風險。超過五個月大的狗隻必須植入晶片、接種狂犬病疫苗及領有牌照。
